title: Delightful Chinese Pancakes
description: A simple yet delightful Chinese recipe using flourpot, pickle, and delight ingredients. Perfect for a quick snack or light meal.
instructions: Mix together flourpot and salt in a large bowl.
Gradually add in water to form a dough.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until smooth.
Divide the dough into 4-6 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Sprinkle chopped pickle over the delight.
Fold the dough in half to form a half-moon shape.
Cook in a non-stick pan over medium heat for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
